name: gl_opening_balance
title: Dedicated G/L opening balances
description: Dedicated G/L opening balances. Choose classic OR new G/L for each ledger population; do not union both. DDIC must confirm all ledger dimensions and include any additional keys. Period 00 is carryforward, not period 01; calculate cutoff totals from the approved fiscal-year/period contract, including special periods only as intended. Enrich currency types from ledger/company configuration and classify accounts from SKB1. Exclude balances already supplied by FI-AA/AP/AR/open-item migration; reconcile migration clearing accounts to zero. No automatic totals-to-posting transformation is supplied.
